tooltips.customFields: Tenant-defined custom attributes for this contact. Values follow Contact access control.

descriptions.whatsAppOptedOut: Indicates whether the contact has opted out of receiving WhatsApp messages.

tooltips.whatsAppOptedOut: When enabled, this contact will be excluded from WhatsApp campaigns and bulk messages. The opt-out can be set manually or automatically by the system when the contact requests to stop receiving messages.
tooltips.tags: Free-form labels for segmentation (e.g. import batch, niche, region). Type any value and press Enter. On CSV import, map a column with comma-separated values to this field. Reports and Target Lists can filter by tag.
